prompts.idle: Production character sprites for American Girl Doll Race. The attached image is the APPROVED LUNA LOVEGOOD VINYL PLAY DOLL identity, outfit and style reference. Preserve EXACT face, long pale-blonde wavy hair, pink knit cardigan over pale-blue top, blue knee-length moon-and-hare patterned skirt, pastel striped knee socks, dark brown Mary Jane shoes, tiny radish earrings and cork necklace. Most important: pink wing-shaped SPECTRESPECS remain WORN OVER BOTH EYES in EVERY pose, blue lens on viewer's LEFT and pink lens on viewer's RIGHT, never held, removed or raised. Warm rounded vinyl face and sturdy 18-inch play-doll proportions, realistic rooted doll hair and miniature sewn fabrics. Personality: dreamy, kindly curious, quietly brave, serene small smile, light slightly whimsical movement. Exactly THREE equal SQUARE cells in a 3:1 HORIZONTAL STRIP, one full doll per cell, clean transparent space between dolls. Same anatomical head/torso/limb size across all three, bodies standing about 600px tall within each 724px square. Everything fully inside its cell with generous margins, no overlap or clipping. Hair remains long, flowing close to her back in compact waves rather than spreading very far sideways. Facing RIGHT in slight three-quarter view. True transparent background, no scene, floor, cast shadow, halo, background color, text, grid or labels. No handheld props or weapons. Three grounded idle poses: 1 relaxed upright neutral stand, both arms resting by sides; 2 subtle weight shift and dreamy head tilt, hands resting loosely; 3 one hand gently touching the outer edge of the glasses while still wearing them over both eyes, quietly curious smile. Both feet on the same baseline. Do not enlarge heads or shorten legs between cells.
